article.story: EMMITSBURG, Md. -- — Andrew Urosevic led Lehigh over Mount St. Mary’s on Tuesday with 18 points off of the bench in a 99-65 win. Urosevic finished 6 of 9 from 3-point range for the Mountain Hawks (3-2). Edouard Benoit scored 17 points while going 6 of 8 (5 for 5 from 3-point range). Hank Alvey shot 8 of 8 from the field to finish with 16 points. Wilguens Exacte Jr. led the Mountaineers (1-3) with 15 points. Mount St. Mary’s also got 14 points and six assists from Redd Thompson. Anthony Arrington Jr. and Abdou Khadre Kebe had 11 points apiece. Lehigh took the lead with 16:36 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Urosevic led with 15 points in the first half to help put the Mountain Hawks 61-27 at the break. Benoit scored 14 points after the break. Up next Both teams next play Friday. Lehigh hosts Neumann and Mount St. Mary’s plays Western Michigan at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
